 Delhi’s GRAP-1 is an emergency response, not a substitute for sustained preventive action
 ThePrint view on the most important issues. 
 ThePrint Team 
 21 October, 2026 05:56 pm IST 
 Facebook Twitter WhatsApp Linkedin 
 50 word edit | ThePrint team 
 Follow Us : 
 Text Size:
 A- 
 A+ 
 -->
 Diwali is still weeks away, but Delhi’s GRAP-1 is already in force. Environment Minister Sirsa says it kicked in later than in previous years. That doesn’t make it better. AQI touches 200 even with the government’s year-round ‘preparation’. GRAP is an emergency response, not a substitute for sustained preventive action.
